summary: Complements other multicast security threat analyses by describing threats to Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) that come from hosts attached to router interfaces. It looks at what a misbehaving or malicious host on a router's local network could do to the multicast routing infrastructure. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Think of a school hallway where a student pretends to be a teacher to confuse the class schedule. This lists the tricks a user's computer might play on the routers that deliver group broadcasts.
